reel.caption: Stock markets are hitting records, but tech is doing the heavy lifting. Here is what you need to know as an everyday saver.

faq.q: Why is the S&P 500 hitting new records?
faq.a: The index recently reached a record high because a handful of large technology companies saw strong gains. When a few massive tech firms rise sharply, they pull the whole index up with them.

faq.q: Does a record high mean stocks are safe?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Record highs simply show where prices are today compared to the past. Markets can still fluctuate, and past performance is never a guide to future results.

faq.q: What is happening with bond yields?
faq.a: US Treasury yields recently hit fresh 24-year highs. Bond yields move inversely to bond prices, reflecting shifting expectations around interest rates and the wider economy.

faq.q: Why is tech dominating the market news?
faq.a: Technology remains a massive driver of corporate growth, with huge funding rounds for AI startups and chip makers. This concentration means tech headlines often overshadow the rest of the economy.

faq.q: How should a beginner react to market records?
faq.a: Beginners should generally avoid chasing short-term hype or trying to time the market. Sticking to a consistent, diversified saving plan helps you ignore the daily noise.
